description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ServiceForYourFridge" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/fridge-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceRequest" name="Service request (symptoms and fridge type)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FacilityRequest" name="Forwarded service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completion notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForYourFridge">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_ServiceCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SymptomsToCenter" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestToFacility" name="Forward request" messageRef="Msg_FacilityRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_FacilityRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AppointmentToCustomer" name="Send appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompletionToCustomer" name="Send repair completion notice" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RepairCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Customer -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Noise" name="Fridge makes strange noises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type to service center" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Appointment" name="Receive appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_RepairCompleted" name="Receive repair completion notice" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge works again">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateSplit" name="Rate service facility?" default="Flow_C_NoRating">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Rate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NoRating</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Rate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_RateDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateJoin" name="Rating decision merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_RateDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NoRating</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Noise" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Appointment" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_RepairCompleted" targetRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Rate" name="Customer wants to rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="UserTask_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsToRate}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoRating" name="No rating" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_RateDone" sourceRef="UserTask_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Gateway_RateJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Central fridge service center -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ForwardRequest" name="Forward request to service facility" messageRef="Msg_FacilityRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestForwarded" name="Request forwarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Local service facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FacilityRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FacilityRequest" messageRef="Msg_FacilityRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_FacilityArrival" name="Facility arrives at customer (random time)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttemptRepair" name="Attempt repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Fridge repaired?" default="Flow_F_Leave">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Repaired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Leave</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repair (additional parts needed)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_Leave</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_Repaired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCompletion" name="Send repair completion notice to customer" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_FacilityRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FacilityArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_FacilityArrival" targetRef="Task_AttemptRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_AttemptRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Repaired" name="Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fridgeRepaired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Leave" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Return" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FacilityArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="SendTask_SendCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
